header.title: Alert
header.description: Block-level notice that fills its container's width and stays on the page, unlike a `Toast`, which appears and goes away on its own. It has four statuses (`info`, `success`, `warning` and `error`), each with its own color and icon. Use it for messages the user needs to see while working: form errors, scheduled maintenance or account changes. `Banner` is the same component under another name.

info.title: Scheduled maintenance
info.description: The dashboard will be unavailable from 01:00 to 03:00 UTC.

success.title: Changes saved
success.description: Your profile was updated. It can take a minute to appear everywhere.

warning.title: Payment method expiring
warning.description: The card on file expires next week. Add a new one to avoid interruption.

error.title: Could not send invite
error.description: Check the email address and try again. If it persists, contact support.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to see the result. The copy changes with `status`. With `isClosable` the × button shows up; if you dismiss the notice, you can show it again.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: `title` is the heading and `children` the description. With no other props, the notice is `info`, `soft` and `md`.

status.title: Statuses
status.description: `status` sets the color and icon. `info` and `success` use `role="status"`, which screen readers announce without interrupting. `warning` and `error` use `role="alert"`, which is announced right away.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `variant` changes the treatment: `soft` (default) with a light background and a colored start border, `solid` with a filled background and light text, and `outline` with the page background and a colored border.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` adjusts padding, icon and text size: `sm`, `md` (default) and `lg`. With `lg` the × button is larger too.

descriptionOnly.title: Description only
descriptionOnly.description: Without `title`, the notice shows only the description. Useful for short messages, especially with `size="sm"`.

texts.description: Session restored. You can continue where you left off.

closable.title: Closable
closable.description: `isClosable` adds the × button, announced as "Dismiss" by default: pass a translated `closeAriaLabel`. Without `open` the notice hides itself; with `open` and `onClose` you control when it shows again.

action.title: With action
action.description: `action` adds content at the end, before the × button, usually a button to fix the problem.

customIcon.title: Custom icon
customIcon.description: `icon` replaces the status icon. Its color still comes from the status. Use a size close to the notice's so it lines up with the title.

texts.title: New notifications
texts.description: You have 3 unread messages in the inbox.

hideIcon.title: Hide icon
hideIcon.description: `hideIcon` hides the icon. The status is still marked by color and border, so make the title clear about what's going on.

richContent.title: Structured content
richContent.description: `children` accepts any content, not just text. A list helps summarize several form errors in a single notice.

texts.title: Check the form
items: The email doesn't have a valid format.
The password needs at least 8 characters.

live.title: Notice as a response
live.description: Show the notice when something happens, for example on save. Since its `role` is a live region, screen readers announce it when it appears. Changing the `key` on each attempt remounts it so it's announced again.

banner.title: Banner
banner.description: `Banner` is an alias of `Alert`. Use it when the notice sits at the top of a page or layout, so the code makes the intent clear.

texts.title: Workspace update
texts.description: Billing moved to the new plan. Review seats in Settings.

tailwind.title: Payment received
tailwind.description: classNames adds classes to each part: here the icon sits in a circle and the notice has no border.

cva.neutral: A neutral tone that doesn't depend on the status, built by redefining the --gem-alert-* variables.
cva.brand: A brand tone with the colored border on top instead of at the start.

css.title: Brand notice
css.description: The class redefines the --gem-alert-* color, spacing and size variables only for this notice.

header.title: Alert API
header.description: API reference for the Alert React component: props, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or its subpath. `Banner` is the same component.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of a <div> (HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, except title) and forwards them to the root element, as well as ref. classNames adds classes to each part: root, icon, content, title, description, action and close.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.role: Uses role="status" with info and success, and role="alert" with warning and error. You can change it with the role prop.
a11y.live: Both roles are live regions: screen readers announce the notice when it appears. alert interrupts and status waits until the current speech ends. For notices already present on page load, consider role="note".
a11y.icon: The icon has aria-hidden: the status must be clear from the title or description.
a11y.close: The × button is a <button> named "Dismiss" by default. Pass a translated closeAriaLabel.
a11y.focus: On close, the notice unmounts and focus on the × button is lost. If the notice matters, move focus to a nearby element in onClose.
a11y.color: Color alone isn't enough to convey the status. With hideIcon or a custom icon, make sure the text says whether it's an error, a warning or a confirmation.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Container. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`. Sets the default variable values.
rules.soft: Light background with a 4px start border. It's the default variant and adds no rules of its own.
rules.solid: Background in the status color, light text and transparent border. With `warning` the text is dark.
rules.size: Padding, gap, icon and text size.
rules.content: Wrapper of the title and description. Receives `classNames.content`.
rules.title: Title. Receives `classNames.title`.
rules.action: Wrapper of `action`, aligned to the end. Receives `classNames.action`.
rules.close: × button. Takes the notice's text color. Receives `classNames.close`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: The status and size classes set these variables on the same element, so to change them use a selector like `.gem-alert.my-class` (see Style changes).

items.--gem-alert-accent: Start border color. In `solid` it's also the background.
items.--gem-alert-gap: Gap between the icon, content and actions.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: gem-system tokens used by Alert. `{status}` is `info`, `success`, `warning` or `error`.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: Also accepts the HTML attributes of a `<div>`. `Banner` takes the same props.

items.status: Status: sets the color, icon and default `role`.
items.title: Heading above the description.
items.children: Description or content of the notice.
items.action: Content at the end, before the × button.
items.role: ARIA role. Defaults to `status` with `info` and `success`, and `alert` with `warning` and `error`.
items.onClose: Runs when the × button is pressed.
